items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: they had bandit every so often, Ben Black and Lou Breed and Rubenov

ctx.x: When a guy's good, I see he's a good guy. He played in the same way too, didn't he? Huh?

He played in the same way. Oh, man, oh, the singer's there, the drummer, he was good too, see. Oh, what's the name, uh, Godfrey, see, good drummer. Who? Godfrey, Adrian Godfrey. I didn't know him. Yeah, good drummer, great. He wanted, he left to go fishing, see, but never came anybody to take his place. He was too good, see. And again, he came around, me, me and my big mouth. I knew Godfrey, man. I thought, I was after Steve and I was talking, this is Godfrey. I said, no, I know what the referee drummer, man. He…
You know, Schlegel. I never did know him.
